problem_type: Agent conversation and control state has multiple durable-looking owners
symptom: Long turns, renderer remounts, or restart can replay prompt text without the corresponding structured item/receipt and can repeat an effect.
direct_cause: ProjectAgentHost records state while the coordinator forces history to ephemeral, executionPrompt rebuilds full text, and each Pi turn can create a fresh session.
class_root: No single durable owner publishes Thread/Turn/Item/Checkpoint state and binds loop output to an append-only ledger.
affected_population: Every Agent thread crossing a turn boundary
Every renderer remount, Electron restart, interrupt, or resume
Every tool call with a receipt or external effect
internal_only_reason: This is an application ownership invariant; the exact #223 source is pinned by the M0 owner map and no external dependency decides it.
invariants: A Thread/Turn/Item/Checkpoint has one durable Host owner.
Pi sessions are replaceable loop implementations and never project facts into a second history.
A settled idempotency key cannot dispatch a second effect.
generality_proof: All checked callers converge on ProjectAgentHost dispatch/coordinator and then the Pi adapter; enforcing ledger append, sequence, lease, and receipt idempotency there covers renderer remounts, restarts, retries, and future loop implementations.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own turn lifecycle, CAS, approval binding, and settlement publication.
Append and reduce durable Host mutations with idempotency.
Run the replaceable Pi loop and return structured items without owning project facts.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Coordinator currently creates ephemeral history and must converge on Host ledger in M1.
IPC requests re-enter the same Host binding and can otherwise replay the same turn.
Every loop result crosses the runtime adapter before Host append; a new loop must inherit the same boundary.

recurrence.reason: Any alternate caller, loop implementation, restart, or future persistence adapter can recreate split ownership if the Host boundary is not structural.
same_class_scan: Searched #223 coordinator, helpers, Host, IPC, and Pi runtime refs for history/ executionPrompt/session creation.
Checked renderer remount and resume as separate callers of Host IPC.
Checked tool result/receipt paths for idempotency and terminal item writes.

prevention.invariant: Only Host ledger append/reducer can create terminal conversation or execution state; Pi output is an input item, never a second history.
prevention.failure_mode: Stale lease/revision, duplicate idempotency key, malformed sequence, or incomplete settlement is rejected or remains non-terminal.
prevention.strategy: Replace ephemeral replay with Host-owned Thread/Turn/Item/Checkpoint and make every loop adapter return typed items into the same reducer.

legacy_paths.rationale: M1 removes the production executionPrompt replay helper; this draft records the required same-commit deletion.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The missing invariant is Nomi Host ownership, not a third-party runtime defect.

migration: Replay existing durable Host items by threadId and seq; do not silently import full prompt text. Unmatched legacy sessions remain visibly non-resumable until an explicit migration decision.
residual_risks: The exact maintainer comment on PR #272 is unavailable, so any exception to this owner boundary remains OPEN QUESTION.
M1 must prove on-disk persistence and process-restart behavior before this draft can become an implementation contract.
